reference_traces.rationale: Reviewer-supported originality of the integrated metabolome, transcriptome, and mQTL network is reflected in final-paper evidence P:S-a59d80215433c98a0ff6, P:S-53dd171e61868156ba1e, and P:S-3f2220b481f73a373613.
Reviewer-identified novelty in HvNAC-1 and MYB/NAC regulation remains supported by final-paper evidence P:S-abaf5e9417dd5a5e67d7.

The reviewer raised the limitation of tobacco-based validation. Final-paper evidence P:S-4bb8b812e9205ccba5c3 and P:S-abaf5e9417dd5a5e67d7 shows that some MYB evidence remains heterologous while HvNAC-1 has barley overexpression evidence.
Final-paper evidence P:S-53dd171e61868156ba1e documents six developmental stages in two cultivars and integration with DH-population mQTL information.
Final-paper evidence P:S-b8c5692371d4c31e8b18 and P:S-57a24efe424ba5fe8735 supports enzyme-level validation of HvUGT-mediated flavonoid glycosylation.
Final-paper evidence P:S-abaf5e9417dd5a5e67d7 supports the reported HvNAC-1/HvMYB-1 interaction with Y2H, BiFC, and Co-IP, alongside HvNAC-1 overexpression evidence in barley.
Final-paper evidence P:S-441ae9c9706100a72ff7 and P:S-4b400169c5e0d4cd3de5 supports the retained grain-colour candidate-gene evidence.
Final-paper evidence P:S-2bc9fb3387015328e49a explicitly retains husks for hulled DH lines but removes lemma shells for naked lines, supporting the residual comparability concern.

Final-paper evidence P:S-abaf5e9417dd5a5e67d7 establishes interaction and individual regulatory observations but characterizes the module as preliminary, leaving the downstream joint mechanism unresolved.

Final-paper evidence P:S-cdbce16ea545ea460a7f and P:S-3f2220b481f73a373613 reports different metabolite totals for temporal parents and mature DH grains, while P:S-2bc9fb3387015328e49a documents different DH hull handling.
Audit-only: the obsolete-reference-assembly concern was addressed by re-alignment to Morex V3; final-paper evidence is P:S-9d6d66cf99a1eb29acd0.
Audit-only: DH hull treatment is now stated in final-paper evidence P:S-2bc9fb3387015328e49a.
Audit-only: the final qRT-PCR methods identify Nt26S and HvUbi as the respective internal reference genes in P:S-d5782bcaa67eac3a61a1.
Audit-only: final-paper evidence P:S-2bc9fb3387015328e49a supplies field-management, temperature, and precipitation details.
Audit-only: the study objective is stated in the final introduction in P:S-53dd171e61868156ba1e.
Audit-only: the supplementary source-data clarification about the reference-gene stability map cannot be independently checked from the supplied final PaperIR spans.

limiting_points.suggested_action: Functional-validation scope remains a boundary on broad regulatory novelty claims.
limiting_points.text: The novelty of broad transcription-factor regulatory claims is limited because key HvMYB results use transient tobacco assays, whereas the final barley overexpression evidence is focused on HvNAC-1.

supporting_points.suggested_action: Not applicable; retained as the reviewer-identified novelty contribution.
supporting_points.text: The integration of stage-resolved metabolomics and transcriptomics with metabolite QTLs from the related DH population to construct BMRN is the central originality claim.

supporting_points.suggested_action: Not applicable; retained as an evidence-backed novelty contribution.
supporting_points.text: The prioritization of HvNAC-1 and the reported HvNAC-1–HvMYB-1 interaction provide a specific flavonoid-regulation advance in barley.

questions.suggested_action: The joint downstream effect of HvNAC-1 and HvMYB-1 remains to be experimentally distinguished.
questions.text: What evidence establishes whether the HvNAC-1–HvMYB-1 interaction has synergistic, antagonistic, or independent effects on downstream flavonoid genes in barley grain?

questions.suggested_action: Cohort and hull-treatment effects on cross-dataset metabolite comparability remain to be quantified.
questions.text: How were cohort-specific and hull-treatment effects controlled when integrating the 986 temporal parental metabolites with the 1150 metabolites measured in mature DH grains?

strengths.suggested_action: Not applicable; retained as an evidence-backed contribution.
strengths.text: The study combines six grain-development stages in two contrasting cultivars with DH-population mQTL information, giving the network both temporal and genetic dimensions.

strengths.suggested_action: Not applicable; retained as an evidence-backed result.
strengths.text: In vitro assays provide direct support for flavonoid glycosylation activity of HvUGT-1 and HvUGT-3, linking network candidates to biochemical function.

strengths.suggested_action: Not applicable; retained as an evidence-backed result.
strengths.text: The HvNAC-1/HvMYB-1 interaction is supported by orthogonal Y2H, BiFC, and Co-IP assays, and HvNAC-1 overexpression in barley is linked to reduced leaf flavonoids and reduced HvCHS-1 and HvCHI-1 expression.

strengths.suggested_action: Not applicable; retained as an evidence-backed result.
strengths.text: The grain-colour analysis connects HvC1-1 and HvMYC-1 sequence, expression, callus-transformation, and regulatory-assay evidence to colour differentiation in the DH population.

summary.text: The paper integrates temporal metabolomics and transcriptomics from six barley-grain developmental stages with DH-population mQTLs to construct BMRN and prioritize flavonoid and grain-colour regulators. Reviewer-supported contributions include the multiomics/mQTL integration, biochemical validation of flavonoid candidates, and evidence for HvNAC-1/HvMYB-1 and HvC1-1/HvMYC-1. Residual interpretation limits concern heterogeneous hull treatment in the DH metabolomics, heterologous validation for some regulators, the unresolved joint mechanism of HvNAC-1 and HvMYB-1, and comparability across the temporal and DH metabolite cohorts.

weaknesses.suggested_action: The variable hull treatment remains an interpretive constraint for genotype-associated metabolite differences.
weaknesses.text: DH metabolomics uses different physical sample preparation by barley type: lemma shells are removed for naked lines but husks are retained for hulled lines. This can confound metabolite differences attributed to genotype.

revision_ledger.residual_summary: Re-analysis on Morex V3 is reflected in the final methods.
The DH-line hull treatment is explicitly described; its interpretive consequence is retained separately as W-1.
The final methods specify Nt26S for tobacco and HvUbi for barley qRT-PCR normalization.
Field-management and weather information are included in the final methods.
The final introduction explicitly states the network's analytic and discovery aims.
The supplied final PaperIR spans do not include the cited supplementary source-data file, so the stated clarification cannot be independently verified.
